name: library-layer
body: Library layer: one root that contributes templates, themes and media to a deck's merged template library. A deck has up to two layers — the external library (the directory named by the `templates:` key in `kalide.yaml`, when the key is present) and the deck-root local `templates/` directory (present whenever that directory exists) — and at least one. The layers have equal standing: their templates, sections, themes and media merge into one library, no layer overrides another, and a name carried by both is a validation error (library-layer-uniqueness). A layer's files are read from that layer's own root, an error names the root it comes from, and the external layer is self-contained (library-layer-references).
